newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Min Xin places HK$338 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Min Xin places HK$338 mln new shares.

text.p: Min Xin Holdings Ltd said on Monday it would place 59.08 million new shares to controlling shareholder Samba Ltd to fund investment in China's infrastructure sector.

The company said Samba had agreed to place 59.08 million existing Min Xin shares to professional and institutional investors at HK$5.80 each before it subscribed for the same amount of new shares at the same price.
Samba's stake in Min Xin will be diluted to 42.45 percent from 49.44 percent following the deal, it said.
Min Xin said a third of the net proceeds of about HK$338.5 million would be used for general working capital and the balance for future investment in China's infrastrucuture sector.
Min Xin shares were down HK$0.20 at HK$5.75 in late trade.
